description: Ministry of Education - Degree Awarding Institute Order. International College of Business and Technology Limited (ICBT)
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the recognition of a private educational institution (International College of Business and Technology Limited) as a degree-awarding institute. While it mentions the Minister of Education by name, this is not a government personnel appointment or structural change, but rather the exercise of regulatory authority under the Universities Act. The content focuses on educational matters (degree programs, accreditation, entry requirements) which falls under the Miscellaneous category as it deals with higher education administration not covered by the specialized categories 1-9.
